data.sub: Hero Splendor Plus ke daam ₹3,086 tak badh gaye hain.

chat.say: Splendor lene ke liye bhi ab EMI karwau?
Papa mileage dekh ke adjust kar lenge!

data.asar: Middle class ki shaan ab thodi aur mehengi ho gayi!
data.caption:
India ki sabse bharosemand bike par mehngai ka jhatka! 🏍️💸

📌 Hero MotoCorp ne apni popular bike Splendor Plus ke daam badha diye hain.
📌 Company ne bike ke variants par ₹3,086 tak ka izaafa kiya hai.
📌 Desh ke daily commuters ki favourite sawari ab thodi aur costly ho gayi hai.

Petrol ke baad ab bike bhi mehengi, par Splendor ka mileage hi aakhri ummeed hai! 😂

Us dost ko tag karo jo Splendor lene ki planning kar raha tha! 👇
